summary: v1.3.8 Real Mobile Mining Worker — backend tests 18/18 passing. APK metadata, mobile-mining/config (auth, masked wallet, signed nonce), expanded admin metrics with new fields (mobile_submitted_shares, total_active_workers, bridge.*), heartbeat fields native_lib_sha256 + mobile_submitted_shares, secret-leak guards, regression endpoints, build-apk.sh hard-fail gate, and WebSocket auth rejection all verified. Frontend admin login → REAL ANDROID tab renders mobile-mining-metrics-card without crashing; v1.3.8 APK card shows version 1.3.8 / 33.1 KB / new release_notes correctly.

minor.issue: Returns 200 + JSON body {error:'device_id_required'} when device_id is missing instead of HTTP 400. Spec asks for the magic string and current code matches request literally, but a 400 status would be more correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Header still labels card 'mobile_mining_ledger · v1.3.7' even though backend is v1.3.8. New v1.3.8 metrics fields (mobile_submitted_shares, total_active_workers, bridge.bridge_*) are NOT displayed anywhere in the card — backend returns them but UI ignores them.

action_items: Update MobileMiningMetricsCard.jsx to bump label to v1.3.8 and surface new fields: mobile_submitted_shares, total_active_workers, and the bridge.{bridge_active_workers,bridge_submitted_shares,bridge_accepted_shares,bridge_rejected_shares} object.
Optional: change /api/mobile-mining/config 'device_id_required' branch to return HTTP 400 instead of 200 (spec marker is satisfied either way but 400 is more correct).

Reminder: /grid-worker-v1.3.8.apk is byte-identical placeholder (33850 bytes) — replace once GitHub Actions drops librandomx.so and build-apk.sh produces the real artifact (script correctly hard-fails with exit 99 today).
critical_code_review_comments: mobile_mining/bridge.py SESSION_SECRET fallback to secrets.token_hex(32) at module load means every backend restart invalidates all live mobile sessions. Acceptable for v1.3.8 since sessions are 1h, but flag for prod: set MOBILE_MINING_SECRET in env so restarts don't kick all phones.

_SESSIONS dict is unbounded — sessions are inserted in issue_session() but never evicted on expiry. Add a periodic janitor or evict lazily in verify_session/aggregate_metrics to avoid unbounded memory growth.
/api/mobile-mining/config: when device_id is missing the handler still calls get_current_user (good) but returns 200 with error key — inconsistent with rest of API which uses HTTPException. Minor.

WS endpoint /api/mobile-mining/worker/ws closes with 4401 on bad token but never differentiates 'no token' (4401) vs 'no device_id' (also 4401). Spec wanted 4403/4404 for nonce/signature mismatch which the code does correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test devices via /api/devices/register + /api/devices/heartbeat with native_pow=true, native_lib_sha256, mobile_submitted_shares — these now appear in admin metrics (TEST_dev_lib, TEST_dev_subm). Cleanup not performed; safe because next run produces fresh device_ids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.3.8 backend is solid. UI refresh to surface new metrics fields + version label is the only outstanding work. /api/mobile-mining/worker/ws should NOT be exercised with a real connection in tests (would open real TCP/TLS to pool.supportxmr.com:443). Use websocket-client with no token to verify 4401 close — that's what the test does. Build-apk.sh hard-fails with exit 99 when librandomx.so missing — verified by reading the script (do NOT actually run it).
rca of the issue: N/A — no production bugs found. Initial test failures (test_native_lib_sha256_accepted, test_metrics_reflect_submitted) were test-payload bugs on my side (HeartbeatIn requires charging/wifi/permission top-level booleans, not is_charging). Fixed in test file.
